meaning:
ὁμοίωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ὁμοιόω) [in LXX chiefly for דְּמוּת, Psa.58:4, al. ;]
1. a making like, becoming like (Plat.).
2. likeness: Jas.3:9 (LXX).†
SYN.: see: ὁμοίωμα, and cf. Tr., Syn., § xv (AS)

elsewhere.note: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.
